observations.humor_and_voices: The organized outing repeatedly follows dog priorities. Neet uses approval/security language and creates a delay by trying to pass Buddy; Buddy actively pursues guest-book access and committee trees, then chooses cool air over trail seasoning. Sagar supplies logistics and the successful private recall phrase; Heather supplies nurturing practical redirection and the backs-of-heads suggestion. Buddy is exuberant here but remains distinct from Neet through smell/comfort priorities rather than rank rhetoric.
observations.cause_effect_and_timing: Snack movement earns attention, attempted passing crosses leads, failed portrait orientation requires the private phrase, and heat reverses Buddy tree and wipe preferences. Cow indifference punctures Neet alarm; the calmer return earns the distant approval callback. Clean-paw repetition follows the first permitted wipe and ends with an actual change of paw. No explanatory text is needed to repair these causal links.

The replacement slim tail remains legible and no reader-level regression is visible.

Stairs v005 occurs after stairs discovery and before the family surges upward. Buddy nose at bark versus Neet on steps looking back makes the competing priorities readable; separate leads fit the resumed expedition after the prose tangle. It does not falsely depict the subsequent climb.

Photo v004 sits after Heather proposes backs-of-heads and before the magic phrase. Neet faces the left bush, Buddy turns to the right, the foreground camera seeks their faces and Heather keeps smiling. It preserves the later successful-photo reveal.
